verdict.rationale: The no-code workflow designer's core objects are exposed programmatically. The docs say users can create, update, run, and delete workflows via the Python SDK or REST endpoints. A job API covers triggering runs, monitoring status, downloading results, and inspecting failed files, and source connectors such as Azure Blob Storage have API reference pages. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of account, user, and admin settings, a public OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
